title: E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch
title_zh: E2E-SWE：基准测试大语言模型从零构建可运行代码库

paragraphs.en: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories end to end. E2E-SWE contains 186 whole-repository generation tasks spanning 11 programming languages. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, an agent must implement a complete, installable project that satisfies a comprehensive suite of hidden tests. Each task is constructed by a software engineer in collaboration with an LLM; together, they develop the test suite and a corresponding implementation-independent specification. To ensure that tasks are well specified and practically solvable, we further subject them to an iterative verification process in which autonomous agents audit and repair task defects using static inspection and failures observed from real model rollouts. Evaluating 13 frontier models, we find substantial variation in end-to-end repository generation ability, with pass@1 ranging from 11.7% to 67.7%, providing strong model differentiation while leaving considerable headroom for future progress. Analysis of agent trajectories further reveals long, front-loaded reasoning patterns, highlighting the planning and system-level reasoning required to construct working codebases from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体正在从局部代码修改向开发完整的软件仓库演进。 然而，对仓库级生成能力的评估仍然充满挑战：任务必须要求系统级的推理能力，同时确保所有被评估的行为都被精确定义，且不受任何特定实现的影响。 我们提出了 E2E-SWE，一个用于评估智能体能否从头到尾构建完整、可用的软件仓库的基准测试。 E2E-SWE 包含 186 个覆盖 11 种编程语言的完整仓库生成任务。 仅给定自然语言规格说明和一个空的工作区，智能体必须实现一个完整且可安装的项目，以满足一系列隐藏的测试用例。 每个任务都由软件工程师与大型语言模型协作构建；他们共同开发测试套件以及一个不依赖具体实现的对应规格说明。 为确保任务定义清晰且具备实际可解性，我们还通过迭代验证流程对其进行检验：自主智能体利用静态检查和真实模型运行中观察到的失败情况来审查并修复任务缺陷。 通过对 13 款前沿模型进行评估，我们发现其端到端仓库生成能力存在显著差异，其中 pass@1 的通过率在 11.7% 到 67.7% 之间，这既有效区分了各模型性能，也为未来进步留下了充足空间。 对智能体执行轨迹的分析进一步揭示了其推理过程具有长期且前期集中的特征，凸显了从头构建可用代码库所需的规划能力和系统级推理。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have moved to the center of modern software engineering. In only a few years, LLM-powered tools have progressed from inline completion of individual lines and functions ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Murali et al., 2023 ) to autonomous agents that navigate codebases and resolve real-world software issues ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . The clear trajectory is toward end-to-end software development at the repository level, where an agent is asked not for a single edit but for a complete, working system.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为现代软件工程的核心。 短短几年间，基于 LLM 的工具已从对单行代码和函数的内联补全（Chen et al., 2021；Murali et al., 2023），发展为能够自主遍历代码库并解决现实世界软件问题的智能体（Jimenez et al., 2024）。 其明确的发展方向是迈向仓库级别的端到端软件开发，即智能体不再仅被要求执行单次修改，而是需要构建一个完整且可运行的系统。

paragraphs.en: Creating a complete repository demands capabilities beyond the localized reasoning and editing exercised by short-horizon tasks such as function completion and issue resolution. Whole-repository development is instead a long-horizon task requiring system-level planning and sustained execution: the model must derive a coherent design from a high-level specification, decompose requirements into interdependent components, establish consistent interfaces, and implement, integrate, and debug the system as a whole. The challenge lies not only in implementing each component correctly, but also in making them work together while satisfying many requirements simultaneously.
paragraphs.zh: 创建一个完整的代码库需要超越局部推理和编辑的能力，而这些能力在函数补全和问题解决等短期任务中已经足够。 整个代码库的开发则是一项长期任务，需要系统级的规划和持续执行：模型必须从高级规格中推导出连贯的设计，将需求分解为相互依赖的组件，建立一致的接口，并作为整体实现、集成和调试整个系统。 挑战不仅在于正确实现每个组件，还在于让它们协同工作，同时满足众多需求。

paragraphs.en: To measure this capability, we introduce End2End-SWE (E2E-SWE), a multilingual benchmark for end-to-end repository generation. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, the agent must produce a complete, installable project whose functional correctness is evaluated by executable hidden tests. Each task is grounded in a real GitHub repository, but its specification and test suite are created from scratch by a software engineer with LLM assistance. Together, they establish a compact behavioral contract for important user-facing functionality while leaving the internal architecture for the agent to design. This setup mirrors a realistic two-stage workflow: a human first collaborates with an LLM to turn project goals into a concrete specification, after which a coding agent autonomously implements that specification as a working repository. E2E-SWE isolates and evaluates the second stage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量这一能力，我们提出了 End2End-SWE（E2E-SWE），这是一个用于端到端仓库生成的多语言基准测试。 仅给定自然语言规格说明和一个空的工作区，智能体必须生成一个完整且可安装的项目，其功能正确性将通过可执行的隐藏测试进行评估。 每个任务都基于真实的 GitHub 仓库，但其规格说明和测试套件是由一名软件工程师在大型语言模型（LLM）的协助下从头创建的。 它们共同为用户面向的重要功能建立了一个简洁的行为契约，而内部架构则由智能体自行设计。 这种设置模拟了现实中的两阶段工作流程：首先由人类与大型语言模型协作，将项目目标转化为具体的规格说明；随后，编码智能体自主实现该规格说明，生成一个可用的仓库。 E2E-SWE 专门针对第二阶段进行隔离和评估。

paragraphs.en: Whole-repository generation from a specification alone has been regarded as extremely challenging, with prior benchmarks ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) reporting near-zero pass@1 (the fraction of tasks fully resolved in one attempt). Yet low pass@1 meaningfully reflects model capability only when the underlying tasks are solvable. By solvable, we mean that every behavior enforced by the hidden tests can be derived from the specification, and that any implementation satisfying the stated user-facing contract can pass regardless of how its internals are arranged. Without this property, a failure may reflect an underspecified requirement or an overly rigid test rather than a limitation of the model. Evidence from better-studied coding benchmarks shows this concern is substantial. In a targeted audit of 138 SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) tasks with recurring model failures, OpenAI found that 59.4% contained material issues in test design or problem descriptions that could reject functionally correct submissions ( OpenAI, 2026c ) . DeepSWE separately reports that, across 789 audited SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) rollouts, the benchmark’s hidden tests rejected patches judged to be reasonable solutions in 24.0% of cases ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . These audits concern tasks that each target a single issue; a whole-repository task bundles many behavioral requirements, creating many more opportunities for a specification–test mismatch, and a single such mismatch can prevent full resolution. Solvability is therefore especially consequential for full-repository generation.
paragraphs.zh: 仅根据规范进行整个代码库的生成一直被认为极具挑战性，此前的基准测试（Ding et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026）报告称 pass@1（即一次尝试中完全解决问题的任务比例）接近于零。 然而，只有当底层任务是可解决的时，较低的 pass@1 才能真实反映模型的能力。 所谓“可解决”，是指隐藏测试所强制要求的所有行为都能从规范中推导出来，并且任何满足所声明用户可见契约的实现，无论其内部结构如何安排，都能通过测试。 如果没有这一特性，失败可能反映的是需求定义不足或测试过于严格，而非模型本身的局限性。 研究更充分的编码基准测试提供的证据表明，这一问题相当严重。 在对 138 个 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez et al., 2024）任务中反复出现模型失败的情况进行专项审查时，OpenAI 发现其中 59.4% 的任务存在测试设计或问题描述中的实质性缺陷，这些缺陷可能导致功能正确的提交被拒绝（OpenAI, 2026c）。 DeepSWE 单独报告称，在审查的 789 个 SWE-Bench Pro（Deng et al., 2025）运行中，该基准测试的隐藏测试在 24.0% 的情况下拒绝了一些被判定为合理解决方案的补丁（Huang et al., 2026）。 这些审查涉及的任务每个都针对单个问题；而整个代码库的任务则整合了多个行为要求，从而造成了规范与测试之间不匹配的机会大大增加，且仅一次这样的不匹配就可能阻碍问题的完全解决。 因此，对于整个代码库的生成而言，可解决性具有尤为重要的意义。

paragraphs.en: To uphold this standard, every E2E-SWE task passes through a rigorous post-hoc review-and-repair loop. The loop begins with static audits of the specification and tests, verifying their one-to-one correspondence. Rollout audits then examine failures from real model attempts, distinguishing genuine implementation errors from specification gaps or overly strict tests that static inspection missed.
paragraphs.zh: 为维持这一标准，每个 E2E-SWE 任务都会经过严格的后置审查与修复循环。 该循环首先对规范与测试进行静态审计，验证它们之间的一一对应关系。 随后，部署审计会检查模型实际尝试中出现的失败情况，区分真正的实现错误、规范中的缺失，以及静态检查未能发现的过于严格的测试问题。

paragraphs.en: The final E2E-SWE dataset comprises 186 tasks across 11 programming languages, drawn from reference repositories with a median of 7.4K lines of code. Despite the scale and complexity of these tasks, pass@1 ranges from 11.7% to 67.7% across 13 frontier models. The high-end score shows that meaningful full-resolution rates are attainable when solvability is treated as a first-class design goal, while the broad spread demonstrates that pass@1 effectively distinguishes models by their ability to build complete projects from scratch.

sents.en: Despite the scale and complexity of these tasks, pass@1 ranges from 11.7% to 67.7% across 13 frontier models.
sents.zh: 尽管这些任务规模庞大且复杂，但在 13 款前沿模型中，pass@1 的得分范围从 11.7% 到 67.7% 不等。

sents.en: The high-end score shows that meaningful full-resolution rates are attainable when solvability is treated as a first-class design goal, while the broad spread demonstrates that pass@1 effectively distinguishes models by their ability to build complete projects from scratch.
sents.zh: 最高得分表明，当将可解性视为一等设计目标时，实现有意义的完全解决率是可行的；而得分分布的广泛差异则说明，pass@1 能有效区分各模型从零开始构建完整项目的能力。

paragraphs.en: E2E-SWE adopts the Harbor task format ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) . Each task directory holds an instruction.md containing the natural-language specification shown to the agent, a tests/ directory holding the hidden grading suite, a solution/ directory referencing the source GitHub repository, and a task.toml declaring the container image and configuration.
paragraphs.zh: E2E-SWE 采用 Harbor 任务格式（Harbor Framework Team，2026）。 每个任务目录都包含一个 instruction.md 文件，其中载有展示给智能体的自然语言规范；一个 tests/ 目录，其中存放了隐藏的评分套件；一个 solution/ 目录，引用了源 GitHub 仓库；以及一个 task.toml 文件，声明了容器镜像和配置。

sents.en: E2E-SWE adopts the Harbor task format ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) .

sents.en: Each task directory holds an instruction.md containing the natural-language specification shown to the agent, a tests/ directory holding the hidden grading suite, a solution/ directory referencing the source GitHub repository, and a task.toml declaring the container image and configuration.
sents.zh: 每个任务目录都包含一个 instruction.md 文件，其中载有展示给智能体的自然语言规范；一个 tests/ 目录，其中存放了隐藏的评分套件；一个 solution/ 目录，引用了源 GitHub 仓库；以及一个 task.toml 文件，声明了容器镜像和配置。

paragraphs.en: Given an E2E-SWE task, the agent starts from an empty workspace with only the specification document, and must produce a complete repository from scratch together with a setup.sh script that installs the repository. For grading, we copy the agent’s implemented codebase into a fresh new container, run setup.sh to install the project, and then execute the hidden test suite. This mirrors how a user clones and installs a repository, to ensure reproducibility. A repository passes only when the code and setup.sh the agent committed reproduce the required behavior on their own, not because of transient development-time state such as build cache, scratch files, or incidental environment setup.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个 E2E-SWE 任务，智能体从一个仅包含规格说明文档的空工作区开始，必须从头创建一个完整的代码库，并附带一个用于安装该代码库的 setup.sh 脚本。 在评分过程中，我们会将智能体实现的代码库复制到一个新的容器中，运行 setup.sh 安装项目，然后执行隐藏的测试套件。 这模拟了用户克隆和安装代码库的过程，以确保可重复性。 只有当智能体提交的代码和 setup.sh 能够独立地再现所需行为时，该代码库才算通过，而不能依赖构建缓存、临时文件或附带的环境配置等开发过程中的临时状态。

paragraphs.en: Environment and networking. Each task has a dedicated container image with all required dependencies pre-installed. Network access is disabled during both the agent’s implementation phase and grading, preventing the agent from retrieving the target repository or related information from the internet. The self-contained image allows both phases to run without any network-dependent setup.
paragraphs.zh: 环境与网络。 每个任务都有一个专用容器镜像，其中已预安装所有必需的依赖项。 在智能体的实现阶段和评分阶段，网络访问均被禁用，以防止智能体从互联网上检索目标仓库或相关信息。 这种自包含的镜像使得两个阶段都可以在无需任何网络依赖配置的情况下运行。

paragraphs.en: Solution. Each task ships a reference solution at solution/solve.sh . It typically clones the original repository, checks out a pinned commit for reproducibility, and then composes the same short setup.sh the agent is expected to write.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案。 每个任务都会在 solution/solve.sh 中提供一个参考解决方案。 它通常会克隆原始仓库，为可重复性检出某个固定提交，然后编写智能体需要书写的相同简短的 setup.sh 文件。

paragraphs.en: Grading interface. The test entrypoint tests/test.sh must emit a ctrf.json report that records the outcome of every individual test. CTRF is a widely supported, language-agnostic test-reporting format, which lets E2E-SWE work with testing frameworks beyond pytest and, in principle, generalize to any programming language.
paragraphs.zh: 评分界面。 测试入口文件 tests/test.sh 必须生成一个 ctrf.json 报告，记录每个单独测试的结果。 CTRF 是一种广泛支持且与语言无关的测试报告格式，这使得 E2E-SWE 能够与 pytest 以外的测试框架协同工作，并且原则上可以推广到任何编程语言。

paragraphs.en: Each E2E-SWE task is authored by a software engineer with LLM assistance. The agent handles most of the heavy lifting, such as generating test suites that run to hundreds or thousands of lines and drafting the specification. The author plays a complementary role, reviewing the generated content, identifying gaps, steering quality improvements, and making the judgment calls on design choices. Below we describe the step-by-step workflow that authors follow.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 E2E-SWE 任务都由一名软件工程师在 LLM 的协助下完成。 智能体负责处理大部分繁重工作，例如生成包含数百甚至数千行代码的测试套件，以及起草规格说明。 作者则扮演补充角色，负责审查生成的内容、发现遗漏之处、引导质量改进，并对设计决策做出最终判断。 下面我们将详细介绍作者遵循的分步工作流程。

sents.zh: 每个 E2E-SWE 任务都由一名软件工程师在 LLM 的协助下完成。

sents.en: Below we describe the step-by-step workflow that authors follow.
sents.zh: 下面我们将详细介绍作者遵循的分步工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on whole-repository generation often evaluates generated code using the reference repositories’ test suites ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Those tests were designed to validate and maintain a particular codebase, not to assess the functional correctness of an alternative implementation. They may therefore depend on private helpers or other structural details of the reference codebase that a correct reimplementation need not preserve. We instead author a new suite for each task, consulting the original tests only to identify intended behaviors and edge cases.
paragraphs.zh: 以往关于整个代码库生成的研究通常使用参考代码库的测试套件来评估生成的代码（Zhao 等人，2025；Ding 等人，2025；Zhao 等人，2026）。 这些测试旨在验证和维护特定的代码库，而非评估替代实现的功能正确性。 因此，它们可能依赖于参考代码库中的私有辅助函数或其他结构细节，而这些在正确的重新实现中并不一定需要保留。 我们改为为每个任务编写新的测试套件，仅参考原始测试来确定预期的行为和边界情况。

sents.en: Prior work on whole-repository generation often evaluates generated code using the reference repositories’ test suites ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 以往关于整个代码库生成的研究通常使用参考代码库的测试套件来评估生成的代码（Zhao 等人，2025；Ding 等人，2025；Zhao 等人，2026）。

sents.zh: 我们改为为每个任务编写新的测试套件，仅参考原始测试来确定预期的行为和边界情况。

paragraphs.en: Each test exercises a realistic user-facing scenario through public interfaces and asserts only observable behavior. This specifies what the repository must do while leaving agents free to choose their internal decomposition, data structures, and algorithms. Authors iteratively measure test coverage on the reference implementation to identify missing functionality, but do not seek to maximize coverage indiscriminately; functionality that cannot be tested or whose inclusion would add only trivial, shallow requirements may be excluded with explicit justification.
paragraphs.zh: 每个测试都通过公共接口模拟一个真实的用户场景，并且仅断言可观察的行为。 这明确了仓库必须执行的操作，同时允许智能体自由选择其内部分解、数据结构和算法。 作者会迭代测量参考实现中的测试覆盖率以识别缺失的功能，但不会盲目追求最大化的覆盖率；无法测试或加入后只会增加微小、浅层需求的功能，可以在明确说明理由的情况下被排除。

sents.zh: 每个测试都通过公共接口模拟一个真实的用户场景，并且仅断言可观察的行为。

paragraphs.en: Authors write the task specification only after creating the hidden test suite. The specification is test-driven rather than an exhaustive description of the reference implementation. It provides sufficient information for an agent to implement every behavior required by the tests. Implementation details not pinned by the tests, such as internal decomposition, private helpers, and source-tree layout, are deliberately left unspecified.
paragraphs.zh: 作者只有在创建完隐藏测试套件之后，才会编写任务规范。 该规范是测试驱动的，而非对参考实现进行全面详尽的描述。 它提供了足够的信息，使智能体能够实现测试所要求的所有行为。 测试未明确约束的实现细节（如内部分解、私有辅助函数和源代码树布局）则被有意地保留为未指定状态。

sents.zh: 作者只有在创建完隐藏测试套件之后，才会编写任务规范。

paragraphs.en: The correspondence between specification and tests is central to task solvability. Every tested behavior must be stated in the specification or follow from a standard domain convention, and every documented behavior must be exercised by the tests. Authors audit this alignment assertion by assertion; when a test depends on a choice left open by the specification, we either make that choice an explicit requirement or relax the test to accept any reasonable choice.
paragraphs.zh: 规范与测试之间的对应关系是任务可解性的核心。 所有经过测试的行为都必须在规范中明确说明，或遵循标准的领域惯例；同时，所有被记录的行为都必须由测试进行验证。 作者会逐条审计这种对齐性断言；当某个测试依赖于规范中未明确的选择时，我们要么将该选择转化为明确的要求，要么放宽测试以接受任何合理的选择。

paragraphs.en: After authoring, each task enters an automated refinement loop spanning multiple rounds. In each round, specialized LLM reviewers inspect the task from complementary perspectives, and a revision agent updates the specification or tests to address their findings.
paragraphs.zh: 编写完成后，每个任务都会进入一个包含多轮次的自动化优化循环。 在每一轮中，专门的 LLM 评审员会从互补的角度审视任务，而修订智能体则会根据他们的发现更新规范或测试。

sents.zh: 编写完成后，每个任务都会进入一个包含多轮次的自动化优化循环。

paragraphs.en: Static Review. Prior to model evaluation, we conduct two types of static review with independent review agents. Test Quality assesses the hidden suite against the reference repository without reading the specification, checking that it covers major user-facing functionality with substantive, nonredundant, and implementation-agnostic assertions. Spec Fairness audits the correspondence between specification and tests without access to the reference repository, verifying that each asserted behavior is explicitly documented or follows a standard domain convention and flagging tests that depend on choices the specification leaves open.
paragraphs.zh: 静态审查。 在模型评估之前，我们由独立的审查智能体执行两种类型的静态审查。 测试质量评估环节将隐藏测试套件与参考仓库进行比对，但不阅读规格说明，以确认其覆盖了主要面向用户的功能，且包含实质性、非冗余且不依赖具体实现的断言。 规格公平性审计环节在不访问参考仓库的情况下，审查规格说明与测试之间的对应关系，验证每个断言的行为是否明确记录或遵循标准的领域惯例，并标记那些依赖规格说明中未明确选择的测试。

paragraphs.en: Rollout-Guided Review. After static review, we run coding agents on each task and collect the test failures from their rollouts. A reviewer examines each failure to determine whether the generated implementation fails to meet the stated requirements or satisfies them but is nevertheless rejected by the test. The former is a genuine model error; the latter indicates a task defect such as an underspecified contract, an overly rigid assertion, or a flaky test. By observing how independently generated code behaves under the tests, rollout-guided review can expose defects that are difficult to identify through static inspection alone.

paragraphs.en: Metric. Our primary metric is pass@1: the fraction of tasks fully resolved by a single rollout, where resolution requires the generated repository to pass every hidden test. We do not award partial credit for passing only a subset of a task’s tests. A repository is an integrated software artifact, and one missing critical behavior can leave it unusable even when many other tests pass. Moreover, test suites differ in their number and granularity, so fractional test scores can reflect how behavior was decomposed into assertions rather than how much of the repository was correctly reconstructed. Full resolution instead weights each task equally and directly measures whether the model produced a complete implementation of the specified contract.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 我们的主要指标是 pass@1：即单次生成完全解决任务的比例，其中“解决”要求生成的代码库通过所有隐藏测试。 如果仅通过任务中的一部分测试，我们不会给予部分分数。 代码库是一个集成的软件产物，即使许多其他测试通过，只要缺少一个关键行为，它就可能无法使用。 此外，测试套件在数量和粒度上各不相同，因此分数制的测试得分可能反映的是行为如何被分解为断言，而非代码库有多少部分被正确重构。 而“完全解决”则对每个任务给予同等权重，并直接衡量模型是否生成了指定契约的完整实现。

paragraphs.en: To characterize the complexity of full-repository generation, Figure 4 compares rollout size on E2E-SWE with two advanced software-engineering benchmarks. paragraphs.en: To separate signal from noise in our evaluation results, we assess whether test failures reflect genuine model limitations or flaws in the task itself. We conduct the same rollout audit described in Section 2.3 over one full-corpus run from each of four models: Claude Opus 5, Opus 4.6, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Kimi K3. For each failure, an independent LLM judge (Claude Opus 5 at max effort) examines the specification, test, traceback, and generated implementation, then attributes the failure either to a model implementation error or to a task defect such as an underspecified requirement or over-rigid test.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在评估结果中区分信号与噪声，我们评估测试失败是反映了模型本身的真实局限性，还是任务本身存在缺陷。 我们对四个模型（Claude Opus 5、Opus 4.6、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Kimi K3）各自运行一次完整语料库处理，并执行第 2.3 节中描述的相同部署审计。 对于每次失败，一个独立的 LLM 评判者（Claude Opus 5，以最大努力程度运行）会检查规格说明、测试用例、堆栈跟踪和生成的实现代码，然后将失败归因于模型实现错误，或是任务缺陷，例如需求定义不足或测试过于僵化。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks push beyond localized edits toward whole-repository construction across varied task formulations and software domains. DevBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) independently evaluates four stages of repository development—design, environment setup, implementation, and testing—supplying each with golden inputs rather than artifacts produced in preceding stages. Commit0 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) constructs tasks from 54 Python libraries by removing function and class bodies, leaving signatures and docstrings as context for reconstructing the implementations. RepoZero ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) derives 600 task instances from 35 source repositories, with each instance associated with one API-usage scenario. Domain-specific benchmarks cover microservices in RepoGenesis ( Peng et al., 2026 ) , interactive applications in ProjectEval ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and E2EDev ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , command-line tools in CLI-Tool-Bench ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and research codebases in Paper2Code ( Seo et al., 2025 ) and PaperBench ( Starace et al., 2025 ) . None of these benchmarks provides a domain-general evaluation of end-to-end repository creation from a project specification alone.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基准测试已超越局部化编辑，转向在多样化任务形式和软件领域中进行整个代码库的构建。 DevBench（Li 等人，2025）独立评估代码库开发的四个阶段——设计、环境搭建、实现和测试，并为每个阶段提供黄金输入，而非前一个阶段生成的产物。 Commit0（Zhao 等人，2025）通过移除函数和类的主体内容，从 54 个 Python 库中构建任务，仅保留函数签名和文档字符串作为重构实现的上下文。 RepoZero（Zhang 等人，2026）从 35 个源代码库中生成 600 个任务实例，每个实例均与一个 API 使用场景相关联。 领域特定的基准测试包括 RepoGenesis（Peng 等人，2026）中的微服务、ProjectEval（Liu 等人，2025）和 E2EDev（Liu 等人，2026）中的交互式应用、CLI-Tool-Bench（Hu 等人，2026）中的命令行工具，以及 Paper2Code（Seo 等人，2025）和 PaperBench（Starace 等人，2025）中的研究代码库。 这些基准测试中没有任何一个提供基于单一项目规格说明的端到端代码库创建的通用领域评估。

paragraphs.en: NL2Repo-Bench ( Ding et al., 2025 ) is the closest prior benchmark to E2E-SWE in both task formulation and scale. The benchmark contains 104 tasks, each asking an agent to generate a complete Python repository from scratch given only a specification document. The resulting workspace is then graded by the original repository’s test suite. paragraphs.en: ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and MirrorCode ( Adamczewski et al., 2026 ) study a complementary formulation that supplements written documentation with black-box access to a reference executable. Their tasks jointly evaluate behavioral requirement discovery through probing and full-codebase implementation. In some cases, determining the full set of required behaviors can be more challenging than implementing them once known, making probing the bottleneck for benchmark performance. In contrast, E2E-SWE states the tested behaviors upfront, disentangling repository implementation from requirement discovery. ProgramBench and MirrorCode also require the reference repository’s relevant functionality to be exposed through a standalone, queryable program, limiting their applicability to repositories organized primarily around reusable APIs or other non-executable interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: ProgramBench（Yang 等人，2026）和 MirrorCode（Adamczewski 等人，2026）研究了一种互补的设定，该设定通过提供对参考可执行程序的“黑盒”访问权限来补充书面文档。 它们的任务共同评估了通过探测和完整代码库实现来发现行为需求的过程。 在某些情况下，确定所需行为的完整集合可能比在已知行为后实现它们更具挑战性，这使得探测成为基准性能的关键瓶颈。 相比之下，E2E-SWE 预先明确了待测试的行为，从而将仓库的实现与需求发现过程分离开来。 ProgramBench 和 MirrorCode 还要求参考仓库的相关功能能够通过一个独立且可查询的程序暴露出来，这使其适用性仅限于主要围绕可重用 API 或其他非执行接口组织的仓库。

paragraphs.en: We introduced E2E-SWE, a benchmark of 186 tasks across 11 programming languages for generating complete repositories from natural-language specifications. Its specifications and executable hidden tests are created from scratch and iteratively reviewed and repaired, making strict full-repository resolution meaningful while preserving freedom in internal design. Across 13 models, pass@1 ranges from 11.7% to 67.7%, yielding clear model separation and ample headroom; a post-hoc LLM audit attributes outcome-changing failures to task issues in only 2.2% of attempts. Together, these results show that E2E-SWE offers a demanding yet measurable test of long-horizon software engineering capability in whole-repository generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 E2E-SWE，这是一个包含 11 种编程语言中 186 个任务的基准测试，用于根据自然语言规范生成完整的代码库。 其规范和可执行的隐藏测试均从头创建，并经过迭代审查与修复，这使得严格的完整代码库解决变得有意义，同时保留了内部设计的自由度。 在 13 个模型中，pass@1 的通过率从 11.7% 到 67.7% 不等，形成了清晰的模型区分和充足的发展空间；事后对 LLM 的审计发现，导致结果变化的失败仅占尝试次数的 2.2%，且归因于任务本身的问题。 综合来看，这些结果表明 E2E-SWE 为长期软件工程能力在完整代码库生成方面的测试提供了一个具有挑战性但可量化的标准。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows a compressed performance range. Except for Claude Opus 5 and Fable 5, every model resolves only 8–15 tasks, with many scores separated by just one or two tasks. Pass@1 is lower than on E2E-SWE for every model. However, two indicators suggest that NL2Repo-Bench is unlikely to be more complex than E2E-SWE. The reported median reference-repository size falls between 1.5K and 4K lines of code, well below E2E-SWE’s median of 7,360, and models also generate fewer output tokens per rollout on NL2Repo-Bench. Together, these observations suggest that its low, tightly clustered scores reflect factors beyond task complexity, limiting its resolution among frontier models.
